projects.title: InsightFlow
projects.description: A fictional landing page showcasing a modern SaaS analytics platform with interactive data visualization, responsive design, and smooth animations. Built with React and Tailwind CSS to demonstrate UI/UX excellence and modern web design principles for data-driven decision making.

projects.title: Task Manager
projects.description: A fully functional task management application with persistent local storage, allowing users to create, update, delete, and organize tasks efficiently. Features include task categorization, due dates, priority levels, and real-time synchronization with browser storage for seamless user experience.
